# Variable `QB_OPT_APPEND`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

When using `runqemu`, the QB_OPT_APPEND variable controls general options to append to QEMU when starting.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-QB_OPT_APPEND)
